Clinisync

In-browser · No data leaves your computer

Drop a clinical Excel workbook in below and the cleaning rules run on your machine. Cleaned CSVs and the manifest are produced as downloads — there is no server in this version.

What gets cleaned

These rules apply to every sheet in your workbook. The output never contains the original NHI, DOB, address, or contact details.

NHI → ID Replaced with sequential anonymized IDs (ID-001, ID-002, …) shared across sheets in the same upload.
DOB → Age Converted to whole-year age, clamped to 0..130. Invalid dates become empty.
Address / Contact Columns named exactly Address or Contact are dropped entirely.
Duplicates & blanks Exact-duplicate rows after transformation are removed. Empty rows and unnamed columns are skipped.

Clean a workbook

Up to 5 MB. Accepted formats: .xlsx, .xls, .ods.
